Helper functions
```{r}
read_summary_individuals <- function(folder_path) {
  files <- list.files(
    folder_path,
    pattern = "^SummaryIndividuals_\\d+\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  nums <- as.integer(sub(".*_(\\d+)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(files)))
  ord  <- order(nums, na.last = TRUE)
  files <- files[ord]

  cat("Found", length(files), "summary-individual files (numeric order):\n")

  data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if ("isLight" %in% names(df)) {
      df <- df %>% dplyr::select(-isLight, -parentIsLight)  # drop non-numeric lamp flags
    }
    df
  })
  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_list, .id = "snapshot_id")
  out$snapshot_index <- as.integer(out$snapshot_id)
  out
}

scale01_safe <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || diff(rng) == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
}
```


Read data
```{r}
data_folder = "../../../2024_12_29_17_15/OEE-data/"
whole_world = read_summary_individuals(data_folder)
```

Sample and save

```{r}
ratio = 0.004
total_n = nrow(whole_world)
n = round(ratio*total_n)

sample_vector=c(1:total_n)
# sample elements from the vector (in this example 30 elements sampled without replacement)
the_sample = sample(sample_vector, n, replace=FALSE)
# the vector of randomly selected elements is then used to select rows from the dataframe
world = whole_world[the_sample,]
```

Save 

```{r}
samples_folder = "../../../2024_12_29_17_15/sampled/"
write.csv(world, paste0(samples_folder, "4pct.csv"))
```


Plot

```{r}
close3d()
plot3d(x= world$created, y=world$pgmDeath, z = world$maxEnergy) 
rglwidget()
```

Pretty plot

Parameters
```{r}
scene = list(camera = list(
           up=list(x=0, y=0, z=1),
           center=list(x=0, y=0, z=0),
           eye=list(x=1.5, y=-0.5, z=0.5)
         ))

# color
feat_cols <- intersect(c("speed", "maxEnergy", "pgmDeath"), names(world))
#feature matrix
X <- as.data.frame(lapply(feat_cols, function(nm) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(world[[nm]]))))
names(X) <- feat_cols

keep_col <- vapply(X, function(v) any(is.finite(v)), logical(1))
X <- X[, keep_col, drop = FALSE]
if (ncol(X) == 0) {
  world$feat_color <- "#9E9E9E"
} else {
  if (ncol(X) == 1) X <- cbind(X, X) #2 dimensions of features

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X))) {
    v <- X[[j]]
    mu <- mean(v[is.finite(v)], na.rm = TRUE)
    v[!is.finite(v)] <- mu
    X[[j]] <- v
  }
  #normalise
  X[] <- lapply(X, scale01_safe)
  Xmat <- as.matrix(X)

  set.seed(42L)
  if (Rtsne_available) {
    perp <- max(5, min(30, floor(nrow(Xmat)/3)))
    ts <- Rtsne::Rtsne(Xmat, dims = 2, perplexity = perp, check_duplicates = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
    emb <- ts$Y
  } else {
    pc <- stats::prcomp(Xmat, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
    emb <- pc$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  }

  #HSL mapping
  e1 <- emb[, 1]; e2 <- emb[, 2]
  h <- 360 * scale01_safe(e1)
  s <- 100 * scale01_safe(e2)
  world$feat_color <- paste0("hsl(", round(h), ", ", round(s), "%, 50%)")
}
```

Save file with colors

```{r}
samples_folder = "../../../2024_12_29_17_15/sampled/"
write.csv(world, paste0(samples_folder, "4pct-color.csv"))
```
